environment.description: EKS cluster running Go 1.19.x container image. The Kafka consumer forwards events to an internal ALB-backed webhook service. No request inspection or filtering is applied between the consumer pod and the webhook ALB. The webhook endpoint processes all received headers and reflects X-Correlation-ID in its HTTP response headers (for tracing). Kafka topic is writable by upstream producers with no schema validation on message headers.

config.network: Pod-to-ALB direct via ClusterIP service, no intermediary proxy
config.kafka_acl: producers have WRITE on topic headers without restriction
config.webhook_alb: internal ALB with no WAF association, default listener rules only
